candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents RBBB, LAFB, first-degree AV block on initial ECG, and third-degree AV block on 24-hour monitoring — together constituting trifascicular block. C001 names only the terminal complete heart block component without capturing the bifascicular block substrate or the progressive trifascicular nature that defines the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the third-degree AV block component but omits the trifascicular block composite (RBBB + LAFB + first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block) that constitutes the full benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite entity (trifascicular block = bifascicular block + PR prolongation progressing to complete heart block); candidates naming only one component should be rated partial
